Package org.saidone.protoalf.platform

Class GrpcNodeArchiveService

java.lang.Object
org.saidone.protoalf.api.NodeArchiveServiceGrpc.NodeArchiveServiceImplBase
org.saidone.protoalf.platform.GrpcNodeArchiveService
All Implemented Interfaces:
io.grpc.BindableService, org.saidone.protoalf.api.NodeArchiveServiceGrpc.AsyncService
public final class GrpcNodeArchiveService extends org.saidone.protoalf.api.NodeArchiveServiceGrpc.NodeArchiveServiceImplBase
Exposes the Alfresco trashcan (the archive store of workspace://SpacesStore) through gRPC.

Listing delegates to Alfresco's node archive service, which shows administrators every archived node and other users only the nodes they deleted. Purging removes archived nodes permanently through the secured node service, so the calling user's repository permissions apply. Archived nodes are addressed by their archive://SpacesStore reference or by their bare node ID; references outside the archive store are rejected so a live node can never be purged by mistake.

Reads run in read-only transactions and purges in retryable read-write transactions as the user established by TicketInterceptor. Responses are emitted only after the transaction completes; errors are delivered to the response observer.

  • Method Details

    • listArchivedNodes

      public void listArchivedNodes(org.saidone.protoalf.api.ListArchivedNodesRequest request, io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver<org.saidone.protoalf.api.ListArchivedNodesResponse> observer)
      Lists the archived nodes visible to the caller, most recently deleted first, optionally filtered by name. A zero page size selects 100; explicit sizes must be 1..1000. The total is -1 when unavailable.
      Parameters:
      request - optional name filter, non-negative skip count and optional page size
      observer - receives one page with entries, continuation flag and total count, or a gRPC error

    • purgeArchivedNode

      public void purgeArchivedNode(org.saidone.protoalf.api.PurgeArchivedNodeRequest request, io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver<org.saidone.protoalf.api.PurgeArchivedNodesResponse> observer)
      Permanently deletes one archived node and its archived children. The node cannot be restored afterwards.
      Parameters:
      request - archived node reference or bare node ID
      observer - receives one response reporting the purged node, or a gRPC error

    • purgeAllArchivedNodes

      public void purgeAllArchivedNodes(org.saidone.protoalf.api.PurgeAllArchivedNodesRequest request, io.grpc.stub.StreamObserver<org.saidone.protoalf.api.PurgeArchivedNodesResponse> observer)
      Permanently deletes every archived node the caller can list, in one transaction. For an administrator this empties the whole trashcan; other users purge only the nodes they deleted.
      Parameters:
      request - empty request
      observer - receives one response with the number of purged nodes, or a gRPC error
